# Pre v Post
Note: All midpoint types collapsed to value 3


This table  allows us to see how many people changed from one given value to another between timepoints.

```{r}
all_simple_change <- table_maker(df = all_changes, 
                                 var1 = "pre_simple", 
                                 var2 = "post_simple")

```

# Proportion table

For the below proportion table, proportions add to 1.00 row-wise. 

So each value in the table is saying "For the given response at T1 (rows), what was the proportion of the given response at T2 (columns)?"

```{r}

all_simple_change_prop <- table_maker(df = all_changes, 
                                      var1 = "pre_simple", 
                                      var2 = "post_simple",
                                      stats = "props")



```
